measurement.concurrentSamples: one operation per reader at 1/10/50 readers
measurement.percentiles: nearest-rank p50 and p95; sorted samples index 4 and 9 for n=10
measurement.heap: JVM totalMemory minus freeMemory delta across case; GC may make this negative, not allocation or peak RSS
measurement.cpu: OperatingSystemMXBean processCpuTime delta; cold row includes case verification and warm/concurrent phases
measurement.storage: retained_bytes: exact SQL cached content; index_storage_bytes: live SQLite DB+WAL+SHM sum without forced checkpoint, or PostgreSQL pg_total_relation_size summed over authoring_read_* tables including indexes and TOAST within isolated fixture schema; recorded after warm/concurrent verification while index remains open
measurement.dataset: 10/100/1000 unique ~600-byte canonical draft GraphML documents; zero release documents or publications; separate publication-only test exercises verified artifact catalog
measurement.liveProviders: none; in-process scripted HttpClient fixtures, no added latency; local Docker PostgreSQL and local SQLite
measurement.hostContention: benchmark job ran serially; idle editor/server processes were present; no dedicated hardware isolation
measurement.rss: process_rss_bytes: instantaneous test-JVM resident set from ps RSS (KiB converted to bytes), recorded after warm/concurrent verification; not process peak or per-operation allocation
measurement.publicationDataset: separate20-draft/20-release/20-publication workload within200 cap;10 warm/restart list samples per combination; publication-only unpublish1sample; fresh first restart page asserts3provider+1catalog/no bodies before warming loops
